comment: User-Agent classification contract for registry usage analytics. forest-cli SENDS the cli prefix on every request; forest-cdn-worker and forest-backend CLASSIFY traffic with these rules. The internal prefix marks forest-backend's own server-side tarball fetches (Code tab), which the download rollup excludes so they never count as downloads. Prefixes match at the START of the User-Agent string; the browser token matches anywhere. Renaming a prefix in one repo without the others silently misclassifies analytics forever, which is why this file exists.
